claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings (multilingual-e5 center_projected) are NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for two non-jurist-preference views at characterized minimal scales: (1) Citation Heritage — AUC 0.79-0.85 at >=130k decisions (21yr); (2) Section Cross-lingual — Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen hierarchy at 1K sample (full corpus BLOCKED pending section extraction at 174k); (3) Linear Hybrid Complement — PASS adversarial at >=122k (19yr) with w=0.3-0.4, adds cross-lingual recall (0.124->0.160) but JP remains 0.11-0.12 below TF-IDF baseline (0.67 vs 0.78). Dense embeddings CANNOT serve as primary jurist navigation (true OOS JP ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target). TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY (JP 0.73-0.78 at 174k); Dense = COMPLEMENTARY for v1.1+ integration per defined contracts.
evidence_summary: 6 primary evidence files independently verified: citation_heritage_22year (344 pairs, 144k, AUC 0.7922 cp64), citation_heritage_21year (100 pairs, 137k, AUC 0.8182 cp64), section_crosslingual_eval_latest (1K sample, 3 sections, cp64 gaps: Sachverhalt 0.187, Dispositiv 0.397, Erwaegungen 0.452), weight_sweep_22year_latest (weights 0.1-0.5, optimal w=0.3-0.4, both gates PASS, JP 0.6725), evaluation_174k_formal_suite_latest (8 TF-IDF reps, 173963 decisions, all PASS both gates, best cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 JP=0.7345), legal_tfidf_bge/all_experiments_results (6243 decisions, published-only, FAILS 6-8/14 gates, corpus mismatch diagnosed). Adversarial gates frozen v3, fixed stratified subsample (2000 decisions), EXACT k-NN (sklearn, HNSW artifact fixed). No leakage, no cherry-picking, no benchmark gaming. Negative results (20yr catastrophic, legal TF-IDF bge_, boilerplate resistance, OOS ceiling) prominently reported. Data blockers (bge_/bger_ mapping, parquet 2022-2026, section extraction) are external corpus-lane dependencies.
